synthesizedFacts.fact: Zero therapy involves stopping all skincare products to allow the skin barrier to reset.
Perioral dermatitis is often triggered by overuse of skincare products, topical steroids, and harsh cleansers.
Zero therapy can lead to temporary increased dryness and flaking as the skin adjusts.
Reintroducing skincare products should be done slowly and carefully after zero therapy.
